title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 3 Great Consensuses

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the hidden Lord want to show through the skill and wisdom seen in creation?
questions.answer: He wants to show His perfect power, skill, and art.

questions.question: How does the passage say people are led to know and love their Creator?
questions.answer: By seeing the many beautiful and decorated things He has made.

questions.question: What response does the giving of many blessings call people to have?
questions.answer: It calls them to praise Him and thank Him.

questions.question: When people see the care given to living things and their needs, what should they do?
questions.answer: They should worship with gratitude and appreciation.

questions.question: What changes in the world are named as signs of His Lordship and Divinity?
questions.answer: The changing seasons and the coming of night and day.

questions.question: Besides belief, what attitudes toward Allah are people meant to have?
questions.answer: Submission, humility, and obedience.

questions.question: How does the passage describe Allah’s justice in the world?
questions.answer: He protects goodness and good people, and He destroys evil and evil people.

questions.question: What happens to oppressors and liars in the passage?
questions.answer: They are struck down and destroyed by punishment from heaven.

questions.question: Near this unseen Lord, what kind of person must surely exist?
questions.answer: His most beloved servant and most devoted worshipper.

questions.question: What big mystery does this special servant solve?
questions.answer: He explains the meaning and secret of why the universe was created.

questions.question: In whose name does this servant act?
questions.answer: He acts in the name of the Creator.

questions.question: From whom does he ask for help and success?
questions.answer: He asks the Creator, and he receives help and success from Him.

questions.question: Who is named as that beloved servant?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: After seeing the nine truths, what title does the traveler think suits the Prophet for humanity?
questions.answer: He sees him as the greatest honor and pride of humankind.

questions.question: Why does the traveler think the Prophet has a very high place in the world?
questions.answer: Because the Qur’an he brought reached and influenced a huge part of the world, and because of his great character and virtues.

questions.question: According to the traveler, whose words about the Creator matter most?
questions.answer: The words spoken by the Prophet matter most.

questions.question: What was the main mission of the Prophet’s call and life in this passage?
questions.answer: It was to prove and announce Allah’s existence, oneness, attributes, and names.

questions.question: What image is used to show the Prophet’s place as a proof of the Creator?
questions.answer: He is compared to a sun in the universe.

questions.question: What special name is given to him because of this high rank?
questions.answer: He is called the Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: How many great agreements are mentioned as supporting his witness?
questions.answer: Three.

questions.question: Who are included in the first great agreement?
questions.answer: The Family of Muhammad, including great saints and people with deep spiritual insight.

questions.question: What does the example of Imam Ali show about the certainty of that first group?
questions.answer: It shows that their faith and certainty were extremely strong.

questions.question: What made the second group’s support very powerful?
questions.answer: They believed so strongly that they gave up their lives, wealth, family ties, and tribal support.

questions.question: What kind of people were the Companions before they were guided?
questions.answer: They lived among an uneducated and socially weak people in a dark time between prophets.

questions.question: What change happened to the Companions in a short time?
questions.answer: They became leaders, guides, and fair rulers over advanced peoples and lands.

questions.question: Who makes up the third great agreement?
questions.answer: Careful and deep scholars who appear in every age and work in many fields of knowledge.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s witness not just a private claim?
questions.answer: Because it is supported widely and firmly by many groups, so it is universal.

questions.question: How strong does the passage say this witness is?
questions.answer: It says even if all devils joined together, they could not defeat it.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the purpose of the beautiful and skillful things in the world?
questions.answer: They are signs that show the Creator’s perfect art and ability.

questions.question: Why are the many lovely created things important in the passage?
questions.answer: They help people know their Creator and love Him.

questions.question: What are people supposed to feel when they receive countless blessings?
questions.answer: They are supposed to feel thankfulness and offer praise.

questions.question: How does the passage connect food, care, and worship?
questions.answer: Since Allah kindly cares for life and gives what people need, they should worship Him gratefully.

questions.question: Which repeating events in nature are given as examples of Allah’s rule?
questions.answer: The turning of day and night and the changing of the seasons.

questions.question: What should belief in Allah’s Divinity lead people to do?
questions.answer: It should lead them to submit, be humble, and obey.

questions.question: What two kinds of people are treated differently by Allah’s justice in the passage?
questions.answer: Good and upright people are protected, while evil people are destroyed.

questions.question: What does the punishment of tyrants and liars show?
questions.answer: It shows Allah’s justice and truthfulness.

questions.question: What kind of relationship does the special servant have with Allah?
questions.answer: He is deeply loved by Allah and fully devoted to Him.

questions.question: What does this servant do for people about the universe?
questions.answer: He explains its hidden meaning and solves its mystery.

questions.question: What does it mean that he works in the Creator’s name?
questions.answer: It means his mission represents Allah and serves Allah’s purpose.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the help given to this servant?
questions.answer: He asks Allah for success and receives it from Him.

questions.question: Whom does the passage identify as this servant?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What conclusion does the traveler reach after thinking about the nine truths?
questions.answer: He concludes that the Prophet is the greatest source of honor for humanity.

questions.question: Why is it fitting to give the Prophet titles of honor in the passage?
questions.answer: Because of his unmatched role, his noble qualities, and the worldwide reach of the Qur’an.

questions.question: What shows that the Prophet is the most important person in the world, according to the traveler?
questions.answer: The spread of the Qur’an and the Prophet’s excellent character and virtues.

questions.question: What was the central message of the Prophet’s life work?
questions.answer: Calling people to Allah’s existence, oneness, names, and attributes.

questions.question: What supports the strength of his mission?
questions.answer: Many clear miracles and many great truths in his religion.

questions.question: Why is he compared to a bright sun?
questions.answer: Because he is the clearest and strongest proof pointing to the Creator.

questions.question: What three large groups confirm his message?
questions.answer: His family, his Companions, and the scholars of his community.

questions.question: What is special about the first group named in the three agreements?
questions.answer: They include spiritually advanced people with deep certainty and insight.

questions.question: Which two people are given as examples from the first group?
questions.answer: Imam Ali and Abd al-Qadir al-Gilani.

questions.question: What makes the Companions’ testimony believable?
questions.answer: They changed greatly and sacrificed greatly because of their faith.

questions.question: In what condition were the Companions before Islam raised them?
questions.answer: They were in a simple, unlettered setting with little social or political development.

questions.question: What happened to them after they followed the Prophet?
questions.answer: They became just rulers and leaders across many lands.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the scholars in the third group?
questions.answer: In every age many of them appear, and they grow in many sciences and fields.

questions.question: Is the Prophet’s witness described as weak or unshakable? Explain.
questions.answer: It is described as unshakable because it is broad, strong, and confirmed by many people.

questions.question: What final point does the traveler make about opposing this witness?
questions.answer: He says no force of evil could defeat it, even if all devils came together.

questions.question: What is one main thing the Creator wants people to understand from the wonders of creation?
questions.answer: That His skill and art are perfect.

questions.question: According to the passage, why are there so many beautiful created things?
questions.answer: So people can come to know and love their Creator.

questions.question: What do the many gifts given to people invite them to do?
questions.answer: They invite people to give thanks and praise.

questions.question: Why should people worship Allah with gratitude, based on this passage?
questions.answer: Because He carefully protects life and provides what living things need.

questions.question: What examples from nature help show Allah’s Divinity?
questions.answer: The cycle of day and night and the changes of the seasons.

questions.question: What three character qualities should believers show toward Allah?
questions.answer: Humility, obedience, and submission.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s treatment of virtue?
questions.answer: He guards goodness and those who live by it.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s treatment of falsehood and oppression?
questions.answer: He destroys evil, liars, and oppressors.

questions.question: Why must there be a beloved servant near this unseen Lord?
questions.answer: Because someone is needed to carry out and explain these great divine purposes.

questions.question: What does that servant uncover about the universe?
questions.answer: He uncovers the hidden meaning and puzzle of its creation.

questions.question: What shows that this servant depends on Allah?
questions.answer: He asks Allah for help and success and receives them.

questions.question: Who is this servant named in the passage?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What do the nine truths lead the traveler to believe about the Prophet?
questions.answer: That he is the highest honor of the world and of humanity.

questions.question: Why does the traveler think calling the Prophet a great honor for mankind is proper?
questions.answer: Because the truths support his special rank and his benefit to all people.

questions.question: What two things are mentioned as proof of the Prophet’s greatness in the world?
questions.answer: The power and spread of the Qur’an, and his own noble virtues.

questions.question: What does the traveler say is the most important message about the Creator?
questions.answer: The message spoken by the Prophet.

questions.question: What was the foundation and goal of the Prophet’s life mission?
questions.answer: To testify to Allah’s existence and oneness and to announce His names and attributes.

questions.question: What strengthened the Prophet in this mission?
questions.answer: His many clear miracles and the great truths in his religion.

questions.question: What comparison is used to describe the Prophet as proof of the Creator?
questions.answer: He is compared to a shining sun in the universe.

questions.question: What are the three forms of agreement that support his witness?
questions.answer: The agreement of his family, his Companions, and the scholars of his Ummah.

questions.question: What is notable about the Family of Muhammad in the first form of agreement?
questions.answer: They include many saints and spiritually gifted people with deep certainty.

questions.question: What does the mention of extraordinary saints in the first group help prove?
questions.answer: It helps show that people of deep spiritual knowledge confirmed the Prophet’s truth.

questions.question: What sacrifice by the Companions shows their strong faith?
questions.answer: They were willing to give up their lives, wealth, and family ties.

questions.question: Why is the Companions’ transformation so striking?
questions.answer: Because they rose very quickly from a weak and uneducated setting to just and successful leadership.

questions.question: What role did the Companions later have in the world?
questions.answer: They became guides and fair rulers over wide regions.

questions.question: How is the third group different from the first two?
questions.answer: It is made up of scholars from every age who work in many branches of knowledge.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying the Prophet’s testimony is universal?
questions.answer: It means it is for all people and is backed by broad, lasting support.

questions.question: What is the traveler’s final judgment about anyone trying to defeat this testimony?
questions.answer: He believes no enemies, not even all devils together, could overcome it.

questions.question: In the passage, what do the wonders of creation reveal about Allah?
questions.answer: They reveal His perfect ability, wisdom, and artistry.

questions.question: What is one reason given for the existence of many decorated and beautiful creatures?
questions.answer: So that Allah may be known and loved.

questions.question: What should people do when they notice the many blessings given to them?
questions.answer: They should praise Allah and thank Him.

questions.question: How does the passage describe Allah’s care for living beings?
questions.answer: He carefully sustains life and provides fitting nourishment and gifts.

questions.question: Which natural patterns are used to point to Allah’s Divinity?
questions.answer: The alternation of day and night and the changes of the seasons.

questions.question: What human response should come from seeing these signs of Divinity?
questions.answer: People should believe, submit, obey, and be humble.

questions.question: What does Allah do for righteous people, according to the passage?
questions.answer: He protects them and supports what is good.

questions.question: What does Allah do to evil people and liars?
questions.answer: He destroys them and brings punishment on oppressors.

questions.question: What kind of servant is sure to be close to such a Lord?
questions.answer: A servant who is deeply loved and very faithful.

questions.question: What important task does this servant do regarding creation?
questions.answer: He explains its hidden secret and purpose.

questions.question: What does the servant’s asking Allah for help show about his mission?
questions.answer: It shows his mission depends on Allah and is guided by Him.

questions.question: Who is directly named as this faithful servant?
questions.answer: Muhammad from Quraysh, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What do the nine truths prove to the traveler about the Prophet’s rank among people?
questions.answer: They prove that he is the greatest source of honor and dignity for people.

questions.question: What worldwide result is mentioned to show the greatness of the Qur’an carried by the Prophet?
questions.answer: Its message reached and overcame half the world.

questions.question: Besides the Qur’an’s spread, what personal quality of the Prophet is named as proof of his importance?
questions.answer: His elevated character and excellent virtues.

questions.question: According to the traveler, whose statement about the Creator deserves the most attention?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s statement deserves the most attention.

questions.question: What was the chief aim behind all of the Prophet’s efforts in life?
questions.answer: To make Allah known by proving and declaring His existence, unity, names, and attributes.

questions.question: What two supports are mentioned for this mission?
questions.answer: His many miracles and the many fundamental truths of his religion.

questions.question: What picture does the passage use to describe his proof-like role?
questions.answer: It presents him like a sun shining in the universe.

questions.question: What honored title connected to Allah is given to the Prophet?
questions.answer: He is called the Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: What is the first of the three strong agreements that confirm his witness?
questions.answer: The united support of the Prophet’s family and great saints among them.

questions.question: Why are examples like Imam Ali and Abd al-Qadir al-Gilani mentioned?
questions.answer: To show that highly certain and spiritually advanced people confirmed his truth.

questions.question: What is the second great agreement?
questions.answer: The support and confirmation of the Companions.

questions.question: What makes the Companions’ testimony especially meaningful?
questions.answer: They believed strongly enough to sacrifice everything and were transformed from weakness to leadership.

questions.question: What kind of society did the Companions come from before their rise?
questions.answer: A simple and unlettered society lacking strong social and political development.

questions.question: What is the third great agreement?
questions.answer: The agreement of careful and deep scholars who appear in every age.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the range of those scholars’ work?
questions.answer: They advance in many sciences and work in different fields.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the strength of the Prophet’s testimony in the end?
questions.answer: It says his testimony is broad, firm, and impossible for evil forces to defeat.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah wants to display through the created world?
questions.answer: He wants to display the perfection of His skill and art.

questions.question: Why are there so many beautiful and ornamented creatures, according to the passage?
questions.answer: They are a way for people to recognize and love their Creator.

questions.question: What feeling should grow in people because of the many blessings they enjoy?
questions.answer: Thankfulness along with praise.

questions.question: How does the passage connect worship with daily needs?
questions.answer: Since Allah gently provides for life and meets needs, people should worship Him thankfully.

questions.question: What signs in time and nature point to Allah’s Divinity in the passage?
questions.answer: The passing of seasons and the turning of night and day.

questions.question: What should belief in Allah produce in a person’s behavior?
questions.answer: It should produce obedience, humility, and submission.

questions.question: How is Allah’s justice shown toward good people?
questions.answer: He preserves and protects them.

questions.question: How is Allah’s justice shown toward wicked people?
questions.answer: He destroys them, especially oppressors and liars.

questions.question: What kind of person must exist to serve these divine purposes among people?
questions.answer: A deeply devoted servant who is especially beloved by Allah.

questions.question: What mystery of existence does this servant make clear?
questions.answer: He makes clear the puzzle and meaning of the universe’s creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about his reliance on Allah?
questions.answer: He acts for Allah, asks Allah for aid, and receives that aid.

questions.question: Which person is identified as having this role?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What conclusion does the traveler make from the nine truths about the Prophet’s place in human history?
questions.answer: He is the chief honor and glory of humankind.

questions.question: Why does the traveler believe that calling the Prophet the pride of the world is suitable?
questions.answer: Because the evidence shows his unmatched greatness and benefit to the world.

questions.question: What does the passage mention about the Qur’an to show the Prophet’s importance?
questions.answer: It says the Qur’an’s authority spread over half the world.

questions.question: What personal qualities of the Prophet are also used as proof of his importance?
questions.answer: His many perfections and his high moral character.

questions.question: What message of the Prophet is called the most important message about the Creator?
questions.answer: His testimony about Allah.

questions.question: What was the basic purpose of the Prophet’s call?
questions.answer: To prove and proclaim Allah’s existence and unity and to make known His names and attributes.

questions.question: What evidence gave strength to the Prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: Hundreds of miracles and thousands of deep truths in his religion.

questions.question: What comparison helps explain his role as a proof in the universe?
questions.answer: He is likened to a sun.

questions.question: What three united groups put their support behind his testimony?
questions.answer: His family, his Companions, and the scholars of his Ummah.

questions.question: What is important about the people in the first group?
questions.answer: They include saints and spiritually perceptive people with very strong certainty.

questions.question: What does the first group’s support suggest about the Prophet’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: It suggests that people closest to deep spiritual knowledge recognized his truth.

questions.question: What sacrifice by the Companions is mentioned to show their sincere faith?
questions.answer: They gave up their lives, wealth, fathers, and tribes for their belief.

questions.question: What surprising change took place in the Companions?
questions.answer: They quickly became leaders and just rulers over developed nations.

questions.question: What does the third group add to the proof?
questions.answer: It adds the agreement of many careful scholars across all ages and many branches of knowledge.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s witness described as more than individual?
questions.answer: Because many major groups across time confirm it together.

questions.question: What strong statement is made about attempts to oppose this witness?
questions.answer: Even if all devils united, they still could not defeat it.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do the wise and skillful works in creation show about Allah?
questions.answer: They show the greatness and perfection of His art and ability.

questions.question: How are people meant to come to know their Creator through creation?
questions.answer: By reflecting on the countless beautiful things He has made.

questions.question: What should people offer because of the many good gifts they receive?
questions.answer: They should offer praise and thanks.

questions.question: Why does the passage say worship should be joined with gratitude?
questions.answer: Because Allah kindly sustains life and provides for every need.

questions.question: Which repeated changes in the world are signs of Allah’s Divinity?
questions.answer: The rotation of day and night and the changing seasons.

questions.question: What three responses should people have when they believe in Allah’s Divinity?
questions.answer: They should show submission, humility, and obedience.

questions.question: How does the passage show that Allah is just?
questions.answer: He supports virtue and punishes evil, oppression, and lying.

questions.question: What does the punishment of oppressors teach about Allah?
questions.answer: It teaches that He is truthful and just.

questions.question: What kind of servant must be found near Allah, according to the passage?
questions.answer: A most beloved and most loyal servant.

questions.question: What does this servant do with the mystery of the universe?
questions.answer: He discovers it and explains it to others.

questions.question: What does it tell us that he acts in Allah’s name and receives help from Him?
questions.answer: It tells us his mission is truly connected to Allah and supported by Him.

questions.question: Who is this servant clearly identified as?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What do the nine truths lead the traveler to say about the Prophet’s worth?
questions.answer: They lead him to say the Prophet is the pride and honor of humanity.

questions.question: What world-changing fact about the Qur’an is given as evidence of the Prophet’s greatness?
questions.answer: Its rule and influence spread across half the world.

questions.question: What other evidence from the Prophet himself supports his high rank?
questions.answer: His outstanding virtues and excellent character.

questions.question: What does the traveler say about the Prophet’s words concerning the Creator?
questions.answer: They are the most important words spoken about the Creator.

questions.question: What was the life goal of the Prophet according to the passage?
questions.answer: To witness to and proclaim Allah’s existence, oneness, names, and attributes.

questions.question: What made his call strong and convincing?
questions.answer: His many obvious miracles and the many foundational truths of his religion.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet described like a sun in the cosmos?
questions.answer: Because he is a bright and clear proof leading people to the Creator.

questions.question: What honored title in relation to Allah is used for him?
questions.answer: The Beloved of Allah.

questions.question: How many forms of unanimous support are mentioned for his witness?
questions.answer: Three forms.

questions.question: Who belongs to the first form of support?
questions.answer: The Family of Muhammad and the great saints among them.

questions.question: What do the examples from the first group show about their level of faith?
questions.answer: They show extremely deep certainty and spiritual vision.

questions.question: Who makes up the second form of support?
questions.answer: The Companions of the Prophet.

questions.question: What did the Companions give up that proves their faith was strong?
questions.answer: They gave up their lives, property, family connections, and tribal loyalties.

questions.question: What major change happened to the Companions after accepting the Prophet’s message?
questions.answer: They became respected guides and fair rulers over many advanced peoples.

questions.question: Who makes up the third form of support?
questions.answer: Great scholars in every age who excel in many areas of knowledge.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the traveler reach about the Prophet’s testimony to Divine unity?
questions.answer: It is universal, firm, and too strong for any evil power to overthrow.
